nodes.label: GET DIC RFQ item list by email token (getDICRFQItems)
nodes.rationale: Entry point reached from the DIC confirmation email: the JWT carrying rfq_number and vendor_batch is embedded in the path so the recipient needs no dashboard account.

nodes.label: Quotation Deviation Analysis
nodes.rationale: Request-vs-offer comparison is pre-computed server side across quantity, price, subtotal, delivery_date, brand, warranty, delivery_address and address_details, each carrying raw values, a formatted string and a has_deviation flag, so reviewers see a consistent verdict instead of every client re-implementing the comparison.

edges.source_location: identical response schema and example; only the addressing parameters differ
items[].vendors[].id feeds the items[].id of the confirmation request body
